title: LLM代理工厂：领域特定LLM代理的检索
summary: 提出LLM Agents Factory，一种基于检索的框架，利用超过2万个预定义代理配置文件，按需构建领域特定且基于维基百科的代理。支持语义检索和蒸馏两种模式，在MMLU、BIG-bench等基准上，以较低推理成本达到或超过AutoGen质量，为工业应用提供高效、可控的替代方案。
summary_en: Introduces LLM Agents Factory, a retrieval-based framework that constructs domain-specific agents on demand using over 20K predefined profiles. Supports semantic search and distillation, achieving accuracy comparable to AutoGen with lower inference cost, offering a cost-efficient alternative for industrial applications.
